entries.name: Appointment Context
entries.description: BEP type, appointment state and requested output maturity.

entries.name: Project Identity
entries.description: Project identity, parties and controlled project codes.

entries.name: Roles and Authority
entries.description: Named organizations, people, governed roles and authority/deferment state.

entries.name: Information Requirements
entries.description: PIR/AIR/EIR/project information requirements and source decomposition.

entries.name: Delivery Planning
entries.description: MIDP/TIDP, task-team, milestone and delivery planning data.

entries.name: CDE and Production Environment
entries.description: CDE system-of-record, states, access and production-environment context.

entries.name: Software Environment
entries.description: Authoring, coordination, checking, issue, viewer, scheduling/cost and exchange compatibility selections.

entries.name: Federation and Coordinates
entries.description: Federation membership, linking and coordinate authority.

entries.name: Coordination and QA
entries.description: Coordination cadence, issue routing, sign-off and evidence.

entries.name: Exchanges and Deliverables
entries.description: Exchange purpose, scope, recipient, formats, milestones and review/acceptance route.

entries.name: Information Structure
entries.description: Parameters, classification, semantics and project selections.

entries.name: External Interfaces
entries.description: External-party exchange, access and interface conditions.

entries.name: Deviations and Unresolved Inputs
entries.description: Conflicts, deviations, deferred questions and unresolved approval dependencies.

governance_notes: The catalog provides a modular index over the existing gap-driven question catalogue; modules are not replayed mechanically when evidence already resolves their project data targets.
A module may be implemented by one or more runtime components, but runtime package names and code structure are implementation details unless separately governed.

Object-specific collection and transformation logic should preserve explicit input paths, validations and output contracts; implementation of those transforms is ordinary engine evolution, not a source-migration prerequisite.

provenance.source_title: BEP Interview Production — Punch List (Readiness to Production)
provenance.migration_note: Normalizes the durable modular-domain concept onto the current governed question catalogue without recreating source-era runtime module naming or deployment mechanics.
